summary: 10.0.34.03 Enterprise Release - Full Desktop 10.0.34 Parity & 26-Item Defect Correction Suite
highlights: 1. Sales & Purchase Register Return Status: Authoritative settlements batch calculation, semantic status badges, and 5-state cmbReturnStatus filter
2. Authenticated Document Streaming: Resolved HTTP-401 AUTH_TOKEN_MISSING across Sales/Purchase Returns, Credit/Debit Notes, and Party Excel Exports
3. Return Refund & Payment Workspaces: Converted popups to dedicated workspaces, dynamic Bank Account enabling by mode, 25MB/5MB proof validation, and unclipped buttons
4. Payment History & Accounting Diff: Implemented Desktop editPayment workflow with Old vs New difference confirmation modal and rowVersion optimistic locking
5. Credit Note & Debit Note Parity: Searchable party autocomplete, cascading party invoice selection, auto-fill taxable amount, and restock inventory toggle
6. Print Studio & UI Layout: Fixed blank white print preview on A4 tax invoices, expanded cramped modals to 520px-620px, and standardized .btn-purple action menus
